endorsements.name: Tony Miu
endorsements.label: Universal DDoS Mitigation Bypass
endorsements.description: Today's commercial DDoS mitigation technologies employ many different techniques for identifying DDoS traffics and blocking these threats. Common techniques range from basic malformed traffic check, to traffic profiling and rate limiting, to traffic source verification and so on, with captive redirection utilizing Javascript- or CAPTCHA-based authentications being the most effective by far. However, in our research weaknesses were found in each and every such technique.

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
